title: Hackathon Projects
content: Kevin has several hackathon projects in the portfolio. ShoulderCupid won MLH Best Use of Solana at MakeUofT 2026. SnapFire won the Wolfram Alpha Award and Staff Picks at AliceHacks in November 2023. Kenesis, the AR gesture-controlled robot, was built at Hack the North 2025. These projects usually combine fast hardware prototyping with software, computer vision, or AI features under short timelines.
